job.title: Senior Data Analyst
job.description: The Ministry seeks a Senior Data Analyst to build economic indicators and dashboards. Required: a bachelor's degree in statistics, data science or a related field; at least 3 years of data analysis experience; strong SQL. Preferred: Power BI or Tableau; experience with economic indicators or in government; fluent English.

requirements.text: Bachelor's in Statistics, Data Science or a related field
